description: This file contains the implementation of a device identification component within the WPEFramework, specifically implementing the IIdentifier interface to retrieve device-specific information such as identity, chipset, and firmware version using the mfrApi.

classes.name: DeviceImplementation
classes.description: A class that implements the IIdentifier interface to provide device identification details such as identity, chipset, and firmware version.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns the device's identity information as a byte array.

methods.name: UpdateFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Retrieves and updates the firmware version using the mfrApi.

methods.name: UpdateChipset
methods.description: Retrieves and updates the chipset information using the mfrApi.

methods.name: UpdateIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves and updates the device serial number identifier using the mfrApi.
